name: Crooks
description: A priceless coin forces a retired safecracker and a two-bit gangster to work together, drawing them into daring heists and global criminal rivalries.

videos.title: Panther
videos.overview: Charly's former life as a talented safecracker catches up to him when he is forced to steal a valuable coin from crime boss Hassan Al-Walid.

videos.title: The Al-Walids
videos.overview: Charly sends Samira and Jonas to Marseille and finds an unlikely ally in Joseph, a washed-up gangster who was sent to retrieve the coin.

videos.title: Red
videos.overview: With multiple killers hot on his heels, Charly agrees to sell the coin for his safety. Joseph sees an opportunity for payback.

videos.title: The Ambulance
videos.overview: Charly and Joseph flee to Italy to seek shelter. Meanwhile, Hassan sends his volatile cousin to Marseille.

videos.title: Old Friends
videos.overview: Joseph sees only one way out, but Charly pulls him back from the brink. Samira and Jonas are discovered by the Al-Walids.

videos.title: Rami
videos.overview: Charly discovers that the most feared woman in Marseille has taken Samira and Jonas. Joseph stumbles across a safe spot for the coin.

videos.title: Madame
videos.overview: Joseph enlists Nina's help. Hassan finds a traitor in his midst. Charly is forced to plan an impossible heist.

videos.title: The Sea
videos.overview: In his effort to save Samira and Jonas, Charly comes face-to-face with Hassan. Everything comes down to the toss of a coin.

videos.title: Bussi Bussi
videos.overview: Pressured by the German police to retrieve the coin, Charly heads to Bangkok to meet an old friend. In Vienna, old foes plot as money dries up.

videos.title: Humans, Animals, Sensations
videos.overview: As danger circles Charly's family in Austria, Charly and Joseph hunt the coin through Bangkok. In Vienna, mob boss Zakeyev reaches out to his daughter.

videos.title: Live Is Life
videos.overview: Katharina faces an impossible choice. While Charly and Joseph are trapped between rival gangs, Rio and Zwanziger make moves with dangerous consequences.

videos.title: The Combine
videos.overview: Charly strikes up a deal with the Thai syndicate to pull off a heist for their sacred idol, and Samira persuades Rio to approach Katharina in Vienna.

videos.title: The Scorpion
videos.overview: Back in Vienna, Charly and Joseph race to reach Samira. Rio closes in on the coin, but the game gets murky. Zakeyev stops at nothing to win.

videos.title: Catherine the Great
videos.overview: As Rio's rampage — fueled by betrayal — shakes Vienna, Charly faces Zakeyev's ultimatum. Samira makes a bold move as it all rides on a coin toss.
